title: Singruok Maber Ngang
stanzas: Singruok maber ngang` ni jogo moyie,"Abiro mapiyo mar omo joga;Rituru maber nyaka abiro;Ayulwang` kik teru; timuru kinda."
Wamok techewa, waritre galam;Nobi ka jakuo ni jo ma ok rite;Ranyisi yango kaka ochiegni,To wakiya ndalo; ber watim kinda.
Mano genowa mondikie Wachne;Kaka Ruodhwa Yesu nobi gi duong`ne;Wachni oriwo singruokne duto;"Neuru, abiro; timuru kinda."
chorus: "Rituru maber, nyaka abiro; Namiu pinyruoth;"Mano singruokne;"Donji e morna, bed e kom-duong`na,Nasidhnu osimbo; timuru kinda."
